title: Enhancing Law-Enforcement Audio Transcription: A LoRA-Based Adaptation of Whisper for BWC Footage
abstract: arXiv:2607.27245v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern policing faces a "visibility paradox" where law enforcement agencies possess petabytes of Body-Worn Camera (BWC) footage that remains largely unutilized for accountability or systemic review due to the prohibitive labor costs of manual transcription. This research presents a framework for adapting the OpenAI Whisper architecture to the unique acoustic and linguistic challenges of the policing environment. By employing Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) through Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), we address the significant performance degradation observed in zero-shot models when confronted with high-stress scenarios, sirens, and radio interference. Crucially, we demonstrate that this adaptation is feasible on consumer-grade hardware (Acer Nitro local machine with NVIDIA 4GB GTX GPU) using 8-bit quantization and gradient checkpointing. translated_title: 增强执法音频转录：基于LoRA的Whisper模型在执法记录仪视频中的适配
translated_abstract: 现代警务面临一种“可见性悖论”：执法机构拥有PB级别的执法记录仪（BWC）视频，但由于人工转录的成本过高，这些视频在很大程度上未被用于问责或系统性审查。本研究提出了一个框架，将OpenAI的Whisper架构适配到警务环境中独特的声学和语言挑战。通过采用低秩适配（LoRA）实现参数高效微调（PEFT），我们解决了零样本模型在面对高压场景、警报声和无线电干扰时出现的显著性能下降问题。至关重要的是，我们证明了利用8位量化和梯度检查点技术，这种适配在消费级硬件（配备NVIDIA 4GB GTX GPU的宏碁Nitro本地机器）上是可行的。我们进一步将这些转录结果集成到基于领域的符号推理流水线中。
tldr: 本研究通过LoRA参数高效微调将Whisper适配于执法记录仪音频转录，克服了警报声和无线电干扰等嘈杂环境导致的性能下降，并证明该适配可在消费级硬件上实现，进一步将转录结果集成到符号推理流水线中。
en_tdlr: This study adapts Whisper to law-enforcement body-worn camera footage through LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning, overcoming performance degradation in noisy policing environments while remaining feasible on consumer-grade hardware, and further integrates the transcriptions into a symbolic reasoning pipeline.
